race.comment: CHAMPAGNE CRUSADER (1) made significant late ground last start to get up for second over 1200m at this track. Strong record with Jefferson Tsang in the irons, including a win. Sure to run well in this suitable contest. STRIDEAWAY (4) is first-up since February last year but was one of the best 2YOs of her year and has been readied for this with a couple of trials. Any market push would warrant extra respect. SO SI GOD (8) turned in an eye-catching run last time out over 1200m at this track, charging home from well back to finish half a length away in third. Generally performs well here and has registered four minor placings. GREAT PROMISE (10) has been thereabouts lately without being able to break through, the latest effort a second at Northam over 1100m. Facing a tougher assignment but should be involved in the finish. DON'T WINK (12) has a tricky draw to contend with but is generally in the mix and it would be a surprise if she's not somewhere around the mark.
